cases.refreshed: Saratoga Library presents classical dances from India by accomplished Bay Area classical dancers. 12.50 PM - Innovation Song by Nivedha Balan; 1.00 PM - 1.45 PM: Mohiniyattam Dance by Smt. Saraswathy Lakshmivaraham; 2.00 PM - 2.45 PM: Kuchipudi Dance by Jaanya Annapureddy; 3.00 PM - 3.45 PM: Bharatanatyam Dance by Smt. Aishwarya Venkat; 4.00 PM - 4.45 PM: Bharatnatyam Dance by Vatsal Dave. All are welcome. Thanks to Friends of the Saratoga Libraries for sponsoring the program.
